messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH ERROR RATE for tenant paladin-prod (VPC:d-42). Observed: 5xx surge + model latency spikes >1200ms. Impact: ~18% request failures, heavy tail on gen latency. Paging oncall marta and sameer. Please acknowledge.

marta: acked. looking at dashboards now. CPU on dedicated pool d-42 is normal. GPU mem looks high on a few pods.

sameer: I'm in. linking the traces: https://console.redwood/internal/traces?tid=paladin-prod&window=5m : most tail seen at model inference step, KV cache misses spiking.

joel_ops: customer says degraded UX for autocomplete in prod, ticket 78912 opened by paladin-support. They asked for a short-term mitigation.

liz_ml: quick hypothesis: a recent model rollout to v3.2.1-forge introduced longer KV prefetch patterns; safe_variant (v3.1-quant) exists and is compatible. Recommend pinning paladin to safe_variant and enabling eviction-tolerant routing for this tenant.

samir_reliability: +1 to pin. Also consider moving paladin off the shared burst pool to their dedicated pool node set (d-42 -> d-42-isolate) for isolation while we stabilize. We can do a graceful swap: set route weight 0->safe_variant and pin until next canary.

marta: can we avoid full tenant eviction? customer is enterprise, SLA in place. Plan: 1) enable safe_variant fallback for paladin (no global change), 2) pin traffic to safe_variant (route override), 3) open real-time console to monitor errors. I'll run the commands.

marta: running command: 
```
redwood ctl routes update --tenant paladin-prod --override model=safe_variant:v3.1-quant --weight=100 --reason "emergency pin - latency spike"
```

marta: update submitted. confirmation id: rtv-8421. Applying on dedicated cluster d-42-isolate in parallel.

incident-bot: Action logged: routes.override by marta at 3258765448 (rtv-8421). Notifying customer contact.

paladin-support: thanks, seeing immediate drop in client 5xx. still some retries but far better. We'll keep support page posted.

sameer: starting a tenant move to isolation pool (non-disruptive) with drain windows: 
```
redwood ctl pool move --tenant paladin-prod --from d-42 --to d-42-isolate --parallel=2m
```

sameer: move initiated. ETA ~4m for steady-state.

joel_ops: FYI I'm patching a temporary throttling rule at the edge to smooth bursts: `edge.limit paladin-prod 15rps` until KV cache warms.

liz_ml: I kicked off a quick rollback test of v3.2.1-forge in a sandbox. Repro shows KV cold start regression. We'll prepare a micro-patch to kernel prefetch heuristic.

samir_reliability: monitoring metrics: error-rate dropped from 18% -> 2.3% since override. Latency p50/p95 improved. Good so far.

marta: paladin support confirms client traffic back to normal for now. Keeping pinned to safe_variant. I'll create a post-incident ticket for model patch + controlled canary of v3.2.1-forge with warmed cache.

paladin-support: appreciate the quick fix. Please keep us in the loop on rollback or timeline.

incident-bot: Runbook steps executed: pin_override, pool_move, edge_throttle. Next: ML team to produce regression fix (liz_ml). Owner assigned: liz_ml. ETA 48h for patch and canary plan.

liz_ml: noted. I'll publish the canary plan and a tuning patch by EOD. Will coordinate with sameer for rolling canary in dedicated pools.

marta: handing off to oncall sameer for next 2 hours of watch. sameer, please post any regressions here. I'll sign out in 10.

sameer: oncall ack. added heartbeat check and alert suppression for the pinned route to avoid noisy alerts while we stabilize.

marta: thanks team. summary for timeline: 3258765432 - incident open; 3258765448 - override pin applied; 3258765465 - pool isolation move complete; 3258765480 - error rates normalized; 3258765499 - handoff/monitoring. Will file full incident report tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

paladin-support: closing interim ticket; will reopen if any regressions. Thanks everyone. :pray:
